parts.text:
The equation for the formation of magnesium oxide from its elements is shown.

$$\text{Mg(s)} + \frac{1}{2}\text{O}_2\text{(g)} \rightarrow \text{MgO(s)} \quad \Delta H^\ominus = -602\text{ kJ mol}^{-1}$$

| substance | $S^\ominus / \text{J K}^{-1} \text{mol}^{-1}$ |
| :--- | :--- |
| $\text{Mg(s)}$ | 32.7 |
| $\text{O}_2\text{(g)}$ | 205 |
| $\text{MgO(s)}$ | 26.9 |

Use the equation and the data given in the table to calculate $\Delta G^\ominus$ for the reaction at $25^\circ\text{C}$.
